fullText.simplified:
第2章、一个问题，两个案子

    王母敲了登闻鼓，看起来是遇到了非常不公平的事情。她口口声声说她的孩子没有杀死史元，是官府抓错人了。
    包公想了想，说：“虽然这个案子不是我办的，但因为它太有名了，所以我也听说过。所有人都知道是王家三兄弟在史家大门外用刀杀死了史元，很多在场的人都看到了，人证物证都有。现在你说他们没有杀人，你是在现场看到了吗？”
    王母回答：“小人没在现场，没有看到。”
    包公问：“那你是有人证，可以证明他们没有杀人？”
    王母回答：“小人没有人证。”
    包公再问：“那你是有物证，可以证明史元不是他们杀的？”
    王母再答：“小人也没有物证。”
    包公听得迷糊，有点儿生气地问：“你人证物证都没有，自己也没有在现场看到，为什么说他们没有杀人？我门外的登闻鼓是能随便敲的吗？”
    王母抬头看着包公，眼里都是泪水：“我相信我的孩子们没有杀人。他们三人都是友好、孝顺又好学的人。平时他们连一只蚂蚁都不肯打死，又怎么会杀人呢？我敲了登闻鼓，宁可被打三十杖，也一定要请包公大人给我的孩子一个清白！”
    包公奇怪地问：“如果你的孩子没杀人，为何路人都说看到他们杀人了？”
    王母只能低头说道：“这……只怕他们都在说谎。”
    包公吃了一惊。在公堂上说谎的话，一定会被惩罚。如果是一个人说谎，有可能是为了钱。那一群人说谎，会是为了什么？
fullText.traditional:
第2章、一個問題，兩個案子

    王母敲了登聞鼓，看起來是遇到了非常不公平的事情。她口口聲聲說她的孩子沒有殺死史元，是官府抓錯人了。
    包公想了想，說：“雖然這個案子不是我辦的，但因為它太有名了，所以我也聽說過。所有人都知道是王家三兄弟在史家大門外用刀殺死了史元，很多在場的人都看到了，人證物證都有。現在你說他們沒有殺人，你是在現場看到了嗎？”
    王母回答：“小人沒在現場，沒有看到。”
    包公問：“那你是有人證，可以證明他們沒有殺人？”
    王母回答：“小人沒有人證。”
    包公再問：“那你是有物證，可以證明史元不是他們殺的？”
    王母再答：“小人也沒有物證。”
    包公聽得迷糊，有點兒生氣地問：“你人證物證都沒有，自己也沒有在現場看到，為什麼說他們沒有殺人？我門外的登聞鼓是能隨便敲的嗎？”
    王母抬頭看著包公，眼裡都是淚水：“我相信我的孩子們沒有殺人。他們三人都是友好、孝順又好學的人。平時他們連一隻螞蟻都不肯打死，又怎麼會殺人呢？我敲了登聞鼓，寧可被打三十杖，也一定要請包公大人給我的孩子一個清白！”
    包公奇怪地問：“如果你的孩子沒殺人，為何路人都說看到他們殺人了？”
    王母只能低頭說道：“這……只怕他們都在說謊。”
    包公吃了一驚。在公堂上說謊的話，一定會被懲罰。如果是一個人說謊，有可能是為了錢。那一群人說謊，會是為了什麼？

sentences.english: Everyone knows that the Wang family’s three brothers killed Shi Yuan with a sword outside the gate of the Shi family home.

sentences.english: Lord Bao again asked, ”Then do you have material evidence to prove that Shi Yuan was not killed by them?”

sentences.pinyin: wáng mǔ zài dá xiǎo rén yě méi yǒu wù zhèng

sentences.english: Lord Bao was confused when he heard this. He was quite angry and asked, “You don’t have witness testimonies or material evidence.

sentences.traditional: 自己也沒有在現場看到，為什麼說他們沒有殺人？

sentences.english: You yourself were also not at the scene to see it. Why do you say they didn’t kill anyone?

sentences.english: Can the petitioners’ drum outside my door be beaten for no reason?”

sentences.english: Mother Wang raised her head to look at Lord Bao. Her eyes were filled with tears.

sentences.simplified: “我相信我的孩子们没有杀人。他们三人都是友好、孝顺又好学的人。

sentences.english: “I believe that my children did not kill anyone. The three of them are friendly, filial, and studious people.

sentences.traditional: 平時他們連一隻螞蟻都不肯打死，又怎麼會殺人呢？
sentences.pinyin: píng shí tā men lián yì zhī mǎ yǐ dōu bù kěn dǎ sǐ yòu zěn me huì shā rén ne
sentences.english: Normally they aren’t even willing to kill an ant. How could they kill a person?

sentences.simplified: 我敲了登闻鼓，宁可被打三十杖，也一定要请包公大人给我的孩子一个清白！”
sentences.traditional: 我敲了登聞鼓，寧可被打三十杖，也一定要請包公大人給我的孩子一個清白！”
sentences.pinyin: wǒ qiāo le dēng wén gǔ nìng kě bèi dǎ sān shí zhàng yě yí dìng yào qǐng bāo gōng dà ren gěi wǒ de hái zi yí ge qīng bái
sentences.english: I beat the petitioners’ drum because I must ask Lord Bao to prove my children’s innocence even though I will get flogged 30 times.

sentences.traditional: 包公奇怪地問：“如果你的孩子沒殺人，為何路人都說看到他們殺人了？”
sentences.pinyin: bāo gōng qí guài de wèn rú guǒ nǐ de hái zi méi shā rén wèi hé lù rén dōu shuō kàn dào tā men shā rén le
sentences.english: Lord Bao was baffled and asked, “If your children didn’t kill anyone, why would the passersby all say that they saw it?”

sentences.simplified: 王母只能低头说道：“这……只怕他们都在说谎。”
sentences.traditional: 王母只能低頭說道：“這……只怕他們都在說謊。”
sentences.pinyin: wáng mǔ zhǐ néng dī tóu shuō dào zhè zhǐ pà tā men dōu zài shuō huǎng
sentences.english: Mother Wang could only lower her head and say, “As for this … I’m afraid they are all lying.”

sentences.simplified: 包公吃了一惊。在公堂上说谎的话，一定会被惩罚。
sentences.traditional: 包公吃了一驚。在公堂上說謊的話，一定會被懲罰。
sentences.pinyin: bāo gōng chī le yì jīng zài gōng táng shang shuō huǎng de huà yí dìng huì bèi chéng fá
sentences.english: Lord Bao was taken aback. If someone lied in court, they would definitely be punished.

sentences.simplified: 如果是一个人说谎，有可能是为了钱。那一群人说谎，会是为了什么？
sentences.traditional: 如果是一個人說謊，有可能是為了錢。那一群人說謊，會是為了什麼？
sentences.pinyin: rú guǒ shì yí ge rén shuō huǎng yǒu kě néng shì wèi le qián nà yì qún rén shuō huǎng huì shì wèi le shén me
sentences.english: If one person lied, it might be for the sake of money. But if a group of people lied, what could it be for?

sentence_translations: Chapter 2: One Problem, Two Cases
Mother Wang beat the petitioners’ drum. It seemed like she had encountered something very unfair.
She kept on saying that her children hadn’t killed Shi Yuan and the authorities had arrested the wrong people.
Lord Bao thought about it and said, “Although I did not handle this case, I have heard about it before because it is very well-known.
Everyone knows that the Wang family’s three brothers killed Shi Yuan with a sword outside the gate of the Shi family home.
Lots of people at the scene saw it. There are witness testimonies and material evidence.
Now you say that they didn’t kill anyone. Were you at the scene to see it?”
Mother Wang replied, ”I was not at the scene. I didn’t see it.”
Lord Bao asked, ”Then do you have witness testimonies who can prove they didn’t kill anyone?”
Mother Wang replied, ”I don’t have witness testimonies.”
Lord Bao again asked, ”Then do you have material evidence to prove that Shi Yuan was not killed by them?”
Mother Wang again replied, ”I also do not have material evidence.”
Lord Bao was confused when he heard this. He was quite angry and asked, “You don’t have witness testimonies or material evidence.
You yourself were also not at the scene to see it. Why do you say they didn’t kill anyone?
Can the petitioners’ drum outside my door be beaten for no reason?”
Mother Wang raised her head to look at Lord Bao. Her eyes were filled with tears.
“I believe that my children did not kill anyone. The three of them are friendly, filial, and studious people.
Normally they aren’t even willing to kill an ant. How could they kill a person?
I beat the petitioners’ drum because I must ask Lord Bao to prove my children’s innocence even though I will get flogged 30 times.
Lord Bao was baffled and asked, “If your children didn’t kill anyone, why would the passersby all say that they saw it?”
Mother Wang could only lower her head and say, “As for this … I’m afraid they are all lying.”
Lord Bao was taken aback. If someone lied in court, they would definitely be punished.
If one person lied, it might be for the sake of money. But if a group of people lied, what could it be for?
